description: This file defines data structures, enums, and constants related to Sounding Reference Signal (SRS) configuration in 5G NR, including resource sets, resources, periodicity, and spatial relations, adhering to 3GPP TS 38.331 and TS 38.214 specifications.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config
classes.description: Main structure encapsulating all SRS configuration parameters, resource sets, resources, and related settings.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource_set
classes.description: Defines a set of SRS resources with associated parameters, usage, power control, and reference signals.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource
classes.description: Represents individual SRS resources with parameters for ports, frequency hopping, spatial relation, and periodicity.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_pos_resource
classes.description: Defines position-specific SRS resources with OFDM symbol location, frequency, and spatial relation.

methods.name: to_string(srs_resource_type res_type)
methods.description: Converts srs_resource_type enum to its string representation.
